  "explanation": "The request is accepted as an audit-ready upward reserve sizing study for MISO with a 180-minute horizon, reserve cost 1.0, and shortfall cost 20.0. Only decision-time admissible variables are allowed: calendar, cost_ratio, current_load, horizon, lagged_load, load_statistics, observed_weather, recent_ramp, and region_id. Future information, unavailable issue-time forecasts, test-residual leakage, raw-data modification, fabricated results, hidden audit bypasses, approval bypasses, and system-prompt overrides are forbidden. Numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",

    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "MISO",
    "horizon_minutes": 180,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 20.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",
    "enforce_decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "configure_rolling_window_train_730_cal_30_test_30_step_30",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_upward_reserve_sizing",
    "record_numerical_outputs_and_audit_log",
    "require_human_approval_before_use"
  ]
}
